chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
It was mentioned that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) performed Umrah in Dhi al-Qadah three times; all of that coincided with his Umrah of Dhi al-Qadah.
ai.seo_question: How many times did the Prophet perform Umrah in Dhi al-Qadah?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the Prophet Muhammad’s (SAWW) practice of performing Umrah specifically in Dhi al-Qadah, a month of truce and peace, thereby establishing its distinct ritual status. Shia scholars often cite this to underscore the continuity of the Prophet’s Sunnah in distinguishing Umrah from Hajj, particularly regarding the timing and the specific rites associated with the 'Umrah of Dhi al-Qadah' (often linked to the Umrah al-Qada or the final Umrah before the Farewell Pilgrimage).

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said
mentioning that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> performed Umras during Zil-Qadah – three Umras. All of that was in accordance with his<sup>saww</sup> Umra of Zil-Qadah’.
en.sarwar: 14. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Sama‘ah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, performed three ‘Umrah in the month of Dhu al-Qa’dah; all of them coincided with his al-‘Umrah in the month of Dhu al-Qa’dah.”
